pr_title: reverseproxy: Keep streams attached when writer detachment fails
pr_body:
When `stream_detached` is enabled but a response writer rejects detachment, the upgraded tunnel still ran in a goroutine after the handler returned. This could leave attached middleware wrappers in use past their lifetime and cause data races.

Use the detachment result to decide whether the tunnel can outlive the handler. On failure, restore any partial detachment and keep the tunnel attached, preserving wrapper lifetime and byte accounting. Attempt detachment only for HTTP/1.1 upgrades.

Follow-up to #7649 addressing @steadytao's [late review comment](https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/pull/7649#discussion_r4177447269).

Snapshot CI also uses the PR head commit SHA instead of its branch name when invoking xcaddy, so branches containing a slash produce valid Go module version queries.

Validation:
- Regression tests cover opaque middleware, an inner writer rejecting detachment, and successful detachment. The original code fails the tests and reproduced a data race.
- `GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1 go test -race -short ./...`
- `go build -buildvcs=false ./...`
- `golangci-lint run --timeout 10m` — 0 issues.

AI assistance: Codex (GPT-6) implemented and tested this change.
